WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM "order"
  GROUP BY account_id
),
account_region AS (
  SELECT 
    oc.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    oc.order_count
  FROM order_counts oc
  JOIN account a ON oc.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(order_count) as avg_count
  FROM account_region
),
account_with_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    ar.account_id,
    ar.region,
    ar.order_count,
    ar.order_count - oa.avg_count as difference
  FROM account_region ar
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(difference) as region_avg_diff
  FROM account_with_diff
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  awd.account_id,
  awd.region,
  awd.order_count,
  awd.difference,
  awd.difference - rs.region_avg_diff as exceeds_region_avg
FROM account_with_diff awd
JOIN region_stats rs ON awd.region = rs.region
WHERE awd.difference > rs.region_avg_diff
ORDER BY exceeds_region_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
